attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: The derivation does not cover arbitrary semantic FormulaEval or adaptive SAT-pruning rules that may realize influence through real SAT semantics without exposing row identifiers; that remains RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N^{arb}.
steps: Define Dict_Q(pi) as append-only entries e=(row a, representative rep(a), rank r, certificate forest F_e, cert_line, first_use_line). Reject entries with cert_line>=first_use_line, cyclic dependencies, nondecreasing dependency rank, or rebinding of a previously used representative.

Compute K_Qrep(pi) by the least fixed point from the final LB_N line: add ordinary bit-explicit dependencies, transparent FormulaEval row dependencies, CTSR counterfactual children, and for every Qrep use add the representative row plus all lower-rank certificate dependencies already present in the prefix.

Induct on proof lines. Ordinary Psys_bEF^- lines use the existing Gamma_bEF parser. Transparent FormulaEval lines contribute U_N+X_N. Qrep lines are simulated by substituting the charged representative expansion and the prior same-theory certificate forest; no new uncharged occurrence neighborhood is introduced.

The circuit extracted from the parsed transcript evaluates H_N using the generator circuit, charged row support, SAT-substitution for exposed polylog queries, and equality patches for E_pi source-row failures, giving C_N(H_N)<=N^{rho+o(1)}+Gamma_Qrep(pi)+O(E_pi N).
Contrapose the same-model lower-bound claim LB_N(1+epsilon). If the right side is subthreshold, the proof transcript itself is a valid upper-bound falsifier for the claimed source lower bound.

For necessity, take the least line u violating strict prefix visibility. Hold all visible prefix bits fixed, flip the hidden private row or unread enable bit, and observe that the transcript before u is unchanged while the representative use can change the selected support or parity. This refutes hidden Qrep as transparent parsing.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This is a restricted parser/countermodel theorem and a supporting Formula Footprints lemma. It proves no lower bound for H_N, gives no NP not subset P/poly separation, and does not naturalize or refute full EF+SAT semantic reasoning.

branch_outputs.branch_title: Hardness-Magnification Bridge Realization: prefix-strict Qrep support audit

assumptions: Circuit model is nonuniform Boolean SIZE over the same source length N; equality patching a bad source row costs O(N) gates.
Proof model is restricted Psys_bEF^- plus transparent FormulaEval lines and Qrep quotient lines with verifier-visible row identifiers, parent pointers, and dictionary-entry ranks.
All row enumerators, support certificates, and Qrep certificates are advice-free functions of N and the proof string pi; no semantic SAT-truth advice selects representatives.
Each Qrep dictionary entry e has cert_line(e)<first_use_line(e), and every dependency of cert(e) has strictly smaller rank or is already in the prefix-closed support cone.
The beta-zero transfer uses only polylog-length SAT queries, so substituting SAT circuits of size L_N^c contributes N^{o(1)} per exposed query block and preserves all fixed target exponents.
Errors E_pi in the parsed transcript are source-row errors, not hidden formula-row errors, so sparse-row patching is charged as O(E_pi N).
definitions: source object: H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)) with M_N=N^{q+o(1)}, generator cost N^{rho+o(1)}, and formula length L_N=(log N)^d for fixed d>1.
target object: same-model nonuniform SIZE upper-bound falsifier for the claimed source lower bound LB_N(1+epsilon), not a proof of H_N hardness or P != NP.

controlled interface: PrefixStrictQrep is a transparent FormulaEval quotient rule whose dictionary entries map row identifiers to representatives only after visible same-theory certificates and all certificate dependencies have been charged.

target-preserving condition: beta=0 polylog SAT-query substitution, fixed epsilon>0, q,rho<1+epsilon, no hidden advice, and every quotient merge is ranked, acyclic, dependency-closed, and charged before representative use.
observable: Gamma_Qrep(pi) is the parser ledger formed from bit-explicit EF, SATeq links, bounded SR_h, transparent FormulaEval support, and prefix-strict Qrep dictionary certificates.
same-theory certificate: a finite syntactic forest proving that two row formulas have identical SAT value within the declared SATeq/TSR theory, without consulting the SAT truth label as advice.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Find a Qrep proof where a representative is used before its same-theory certificate is charged, or where a cyclic/nondecreasing-rank merge remains sound under all private-row spoofings; such an example refutes this restricted rule case.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: This closes a proof-audit loophole in the TransparentRowSupport_N theorem pair by making quotient compression a finite verifier-visible rule case rather than an informal Gamma reduction.
candidate_lemmas.statement: In Psys_sym^{dag+Qrep}, proof-carrying quotient compression is a valid TransparentRowSupport_N rule case exactly when every representative dictionary use is preceded, at a strict earlier proof prefix, by a ranked same-theory certificate forest whose dependencies are already charged. Under this condition the Gamma line induction extends with a Qrep dictionary charge; if strict prefix visibility fails, the first unsafe merge gives a private-row falsifier.

assumptions: The proof verifier before line u reads only surfaced row identifiers, prior certificates, and charged dictionary entries.
The hidden row has no prior dependency path into K_Qrep(pi); otherwise it would already be charged and the event would not be unsafe.
The spoofed row is selected so that all same-theory obligations visible before u remain satisfied in both worlds.
The private-row construction is relativizing at the occurrence-label layer, so it does not refute real SAT semantics; it refutes only hidden-support parser claims.

target object: a countermodel theorem for hidden FormulaEval/Qrep support, yielding a subthreshold circuit falsifier rather than a lower bound.
bridge or observable: the first unsafe dictionary event u, defined as the least proof line where a representative is used without a prior charged same-theory certificate.
carrier manipulation: flip the private SAT label or unread enable bit of the uncharged row while preserving all visible proof syntax before u.

Thus uncharged Qrep is not valid transparent support.

held_fixed_controls: M_N=N^{q+o(1)}, q<1+epsilon, and L_N=(log N)^d with d>1 so the target transfer remains beta=0.

gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The remaining ambiguity is temporal: acyclicity alone does not show that a quotient certificate is available before the proof uses the representative. A symbolic proof line tries to replace B by representative A in a FormulaEval support cone, either before or after a visible same-theory certificate cert(A,B) is charged.
